A.7.8 GET_PORT_MOD reverse and complementary masks

implemented.context: PortBank explicit physical capacities/directions, module metadata, logical assignments/modes and pending settings
implemented.assignments: Direction-compatible bounded spans; BOOLEAN batches 1..8 normalized per point, group widths 1..32 and single analog points
implemented.modes: Masks 0..3; complementary requires an odd BOOLEAN output with a following configured logical point
implemented.lifecycle: SET stages, GET reads active; host apply_configuration applies all pending rows and clears them; task POWERUP does not apply configuration
implemented.persistence: Independent active/pending typed context save/load and detached host snapshots; legacy logical value snapshot shape preserved
implemented.failures: Complete-batch preflight, exact disjoint outputs, once-only ordered argument evaluation and retained earlier effects

portable_choices: All logical and physical type codes are explicitly supplied; no native enum discovery
GET reads active settings before host application; native read-before-power-up behavior is not claimed
Coordinates 0..32767, physical capacity 1..32767, group width at most 32 and analog width 1 bound portable metadata
Mode and mapping metadata does not acquire, copy, invert, complement, initialize or rescale logical/physical values
Physical span sharing is allowed as metadata; no physical ownership arbitration
Portable statuses 0 success, 1 assignment/module absent, 2 address/coordinate, 3 invalid mapping/mode; no native alarm mapping
remaining: Physical signal adapters and wiring semantics
